description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling S3 UseArnRegion configuration. It provides methods to create configuration providers based on environment variables, INI files, and fallback defaults, and supports composing multiple providers into a chain.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to generate configuration providers for AWS S3 UseArnRegion settings, supporting environment variables, INI files, and default fallback options.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on a specified INI configuration file and profile.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options when other sources are unavailable.
